hooks.command: bash -c 'in=$(cat); q=$(printf "\047"); re="(^|[[:space:]\";|&(<>=/~])[.][^[:space:]\"]*[*?]"; case "$in" in *[Gg][Ii][Tt]*|*GUARD_*|*\\*|*"$q"*|*[!:,[]{*|*[[]*) ;; *) [[ "$in" =~ $re ]] || exit 0 ;; esac; ( source "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/guard/node22.sh && printf "%s" "$in" | node "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/guard/claude-pretool.mjs ); [ $? -eq 0 ] && exit 0; exit 2'
